Fixed issue with settings not working from the pause menu
 Working AI options; AI should be a little easier overall
 Fixed issues with Dual Shock 4 support issue on Mac
 Working mouse support on main menu
 Other minor fixes

notes.title: Updates for March 21, 2021
notes.content:
AI is much less good now.
 More AI Options
 Moved round options to a top level menu
 Pause menu can navigate back to level select and player select
 Top level menu mouse options

notes.title: Updates for March 21
notes.content:
Added AI levels. They're now not as good and maybe beatable?
 Moved round options to top level menu.
 Pause menu now contains options for level selection and character selection.
 Mouse support on top-level menu (you'll still need it for the player select).

Fixed weird text overlay on ties
 Default npc selection
 Moved round options to a separate menu
 Players can go to level and player select screens from the pause/post-match menu
 UI updates
 +1 to cheese
